items.title: Retirement Benefits
items.description: Retirement by length of contribution, by age, with rural or hazardous work credit. Benefit approval and amount review.

items.title: Disability Benefits
items.description: If you are unable to work due to illness, you may be entitled to temporary or permanent disability benefits.

items.title: Accident Benefits
items.description: Benefit granted to policyholders who suffered an accident resulting in reduced work capacity.

items.title: Income Tax Exemption
items.description: Tax exemption for serious medical conditions such as cancer, severe heart disease, mental disorders, and others.

items.title: LOAS (BPC)
items.description: Social assistance benefit for disabled individuals or elderly people in low-income situations.

items.title: Mortgage Discharge
items.description: Contract review for the possibility of property payoff in the event of disability or death of the borrower.

items.title: Survivor's Pension
items.description: Benefit paid to dependents of a deceased policyholder. Review of amounts and shares.

items.title: 25% Supplement
items.description: Additional allowance for disability retirees who require assistance from a caregiver.

videos.subtitle: Watch our videos and stay informed about the social security rules that can make a difference in your benefits.
